decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution sits close to the firm's aviation security know-how and has proven government adoption through the UK Home Office and more than 30 APIS connections, so the firm can readily interpret its results and keep improving it.

The travel health requirements API builds on the firm's established document and travel compliance expertise and remained on its own page in 2024, but demand has faded since the pandemic and it shows no quantified results, so dropping it is a moderate risk.

The travel and document verification platform is close to the firm's core document-checking capabilities, so its related knowledge lets it assimilate feedback and integrate the platform with its airline offerings.
